name: Mutsu
source:
"....Slashing. It is my very essence."

A mystifying presence among the quartet of Night Ogres terrorizing Ouma City, Mutsu is referred to as the "Blade Ogre" by those in the demon-slaying community. A study in stillness, this taciturn girl is an enigma wrapped in silence. Her stone-faced demeanor belies a heart of unwavering loyalty and purity.

Sworn to [url=/c126891]Charlotte[/url], Mutsu executes missions ranging from frontline combat to shadow operations. Her arsenal consists of three enchanted swords, each imbued with unique properties. With each blade she draws, Mutsu's abilities and fighting style shift dramatically, keeping her foes forever on their toes.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://escude.co.jp/product/sen_nagi/chara05.html]official website[/url]]
